_doc: Known patches to third-party RN packages. Paths in each patch are relative to the package root (node_modules/<package>). tested = the version the patch was written against; applicability on other versions is decided by a dry run, not by this field. measure = how to A/B it with perf-climb. needs: rn-from-source = native React Native core must be compiled from source (RCT_USE_PREBUILT_RNCORE=0 / buildReactNativeFromSource) in BOTH baseline and candidate builds.

patches.what: Keep the text layout measured off the main thread and reuse it at first draw instead of re-laying out in drawAttributedString:
patches.helps_when: text-heavy lists or feeds (many <Text> first draws while scrolling or at launch)
patches.measured: iPhone 16 Pro Max, Release, 30 s feed fling: main-thread drawAttributedString: ~570 ms -> 160 ms; JS thread +~300 ms; about half of prepared layouts are never drawn

measure.scenario: fling a text-heavy list for 30 s (Release)
measure.metric: main-thread time in drawAttributedString: (xctrace Time Profiler, perf-climb profile), plus hitch count; watch JS-thread time, it goes up

patches.what: Restore the invalidation guard so queued rendering updates can't call a destroyed SchedulerDelegate (EXC_BAD_ACCESS in Scheduler::uiManagerDidFinishTransaction)
patches.helps_when: crash reports in Scheduler::uiManagerDidFinishTransaction / uiManagerDidDispatchCommand, surfaces torn down during updates
patches.upstream: RN #58138 / #56892 merged; 0.88 removed the guard again

patches.what: Skip children that became null re-entrantly during subview clipping instead of throwing 'Required value was null'
patches.helps_when: removeClippedSubviews + animated smooth scroll on Android (IllegalStateException in updateSubviewClipStatus)

patches.what: Dismiss the whole modal stack when the modal presented a child controller (blank undismissable sheet)
patches.helps_when: a system alert (e.g. Undo Typing) or child VC is up while an RN Modal closes
patches.upstream: RN PR #58364 merged after 0.88; drop when the release contains f20f857

patches.what: Hairline borders (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth) no longer vanish at some subpixel Y offsets on Fabric
patches.helps_when: dividers drawn as hairline borders disappear on some rows

patches.what: Defer RefreshControl tintColor/progressViewOffset writes until attached: restores pull haptic (iOS 17.4+) and offset (iOS 26)
patches.helps_when: pull-to-refresh lost its haptic or spinner offset on New Arch

patches.what: Scroll the caret into view after a multiline TextInput grows
patches.helps_when: composer inputs that grow with content

patches.what: Turn off Fabric ScrollView view recycling so a recycled ScrollView can't carry contentInset changes (e.g. from Reanimated) into the next one
patches.helps_when: wrong insets on newly mounted ScrollViews after animating insets. Costs a little mount time: measure it

patches.what: Don't dirty shadow nodes' Yoga nodes on every clone (re-layout storm while transforms animate). MIXED: the file also has Android RecyclerView transition and iOS secure-view snapshot fixes
patches.helps_when: scrolling screens with animated headers/transforms inside react-native-screens
patches.measured: iOS simulator, Debug dev client, 15 s scroll of a profile Media tab: 2.06 s of 5.8 s main-thread time was this layout work before the patch

measure.scenario: scroll a screen with an animated header for 15 s
measure.metric: main-thread time in Yoga layout (Time Profiler), hitches

patches.what: Don't enumerate every installed font at iOS launch. MIXED: also an Android Bitdrift network-interceptor change
patches.helps_when: apps that register custom fonts, worst with WOFF2
patches.measured: iPhone 14 Pro: ~15 ms main thread at launch with TTF Inter, ~230 ms with WOFF2

measure.metric: launch to first frame / first text measurement

patches.what: Downscale large images on a background queue instead of the main thread; guard stale loads
patches.helps_when: feeds/galleries of large images in small views

measure.metric: main-thread time in image downscale, hitches

patches.what: Cache parsed SVG `d` paths in PathView on Android. MIXED: also web prop/type fixes
patches.helps_when: many SVG icons re-rendering on Android

measure.scenario: scroll a list of SVG icons on Android

patches.what: Prevent JNI crashes when worklets outlive React host teardown
patches.helps_when: Android crashes on reload / host teardown with Reanimated
